text: Ok now the Recent and Favorites tabs in this asset explorer dont show recents or favorites at all
resolution: Favorites and Recent now render real mixed Asset Explorer collections in both tucked and expanded layouts. Favorites derives from live model favorite state and catalog asset overrides; Recent records model tree selections, model opens, asset selections, selected world-object assets, and applied materials in newest-first deduplicated order. Existing search text filters the selected collection instead of masking it.
